function.name: update_registration
function.description: Update only supplied new or corrected fields in this call’s unsaved draft. Accept out-of-order details. Set reset=true only when caller requests start over. Any edit invalidates prior review. This does NOT save a patient.

first_name.description: First name: letters, hyphens and apostrophes, 1-50 characters.

last_name.description: Last name: letters, hyphens and apostrophes, 1-50 characters.

date_of_birth.description: Nonfuture date, MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Ask when ambiguous.

phone_number.description: 10 US digits; +1 prefix may be supplied.

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation or DC.

zip_code.description: Five-digit ZIP or ZIP+4; preserve leading zeros.

preferred_language.description: English if omitted; do not send null.

function.name: review_registration
function.description: Validate the complete draft and return every value in a readback plus a short-lived review token. Read the FULL readback aloud and WAIT for a new patient yes before confirming. No patient is saved.

function.name: confirm_registration
function.description: Save only the exact currently reviewed draft AFTER reading every detail and receiving a NEW explicit patient confirmation. Copy the latest review token and exact whole affirmative utterance. Never remove a correction or qualifier. Returns saved only after database commit. Retry identical arguments on uncertain transport failure.

review_token.description: Opaque token from the most recent review_registration response.

confirmation.description: The patient’s exact entire NEW affirmative utterance after the full readback, such as Yes, please save. Never fabricate or paraphrase.
